parameters.query: SELECT l.*,u.unit_code,u.address FROM leads l JOIN units u ON u.id=l.unit_id WHERE l.ref_token=$1 AND l.status='prequalified' AND l.prequal_result='clear' AND l.tour_approval_state<>'pending' AND u.status='available' AND lower(l.prospect_email)=lower('__PROSPECT_EMAIL__') LIMIT 1;
SELECT * FROM tour_policy WHERE is_active ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1;

UPDATE leads SET pending_tour_starts_at=$2::timestamptz,tour_approval_state='pending',conversation_state=conversation_state||jsonb_build_object('pending_tour_action_id',$3::text) WHERE ref_token=$1 AND status='prequalified' AND tour_approval_state<>'pending' RETURNING *;

parameters.query: UPDATE leads SET tour_approval_state=CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN 'approved' ELSE 'declined' END,conversation_state=conversation_state||jsonb_build_object('tour_decided_by',$3::text,'tour_decided_at',now(),'tour_decision_action_id',$4::text) WHERE ref_token=$1 AND tour_approval_state='pending' AND conversation_state->>'pending_tour_action_id'=$5 AND status='prequalified' RETURNING *, (SELECT unit_code FROM units WHERE id=leads.unit_id) AS unit_code,(SELECT address FROM units WHERE id=leads.unit_id) AS address;

UPDATE leads SET calcom_booking_uid=$2,tour_starts_at=$3::timestamptz,lock_code=$4,lock_code_source='mock',pending_tour_starts_at=NULL,status='tour_booked' WHERE ref_token=$1 AND tour_approval_state='approved' AND calcom_booking_uid IS NULL RETURNING *;

parameters.query: INSERT INTO message_log(ref_token,direction,channel,tier,from_addr,to_addr,body,message_id) SELECT ref_token,'outbound','telegram','A','leasing-team',$1::text,$2,$3 FROM leads WHERE telegram_chat_id=$1::text::bigint ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 ON CONFLICT(message_id) DO NOTHING;

SELECT * FROM (SELECT l.ref_token, l.prospect_name, l.prospect_email, u.unit_code,
 l.status AS lead_status, l.move_in_date, l.stated_monthly_income, l.tour_starts_at,
 a.ref_token AS application_ref, a.status AS application_status, a.decision,
 a.lease_status, a.verified_monthly_income, l.tour_approval_state,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM message_log m WHERE m.message_id='mail-welcome-'||a.ref_token AND m.guardrail_result->>'delivery'='sent') AS welcome_sent,
 a.income_comparison->>'mismatch_flagged' AS mismatch_flagged,
 a.income_comparison->>'document_variance_pct' AS variance_pct,
 GREATEST(l.updated_at,COALESCE(a.updated_at,l.updated_at)) AS updated_at
 FROM leads l JOIN units u ON u.id=l.unit_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM applications WHERE lead_id=l.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) a ON true
 UNION ALL
 SELECT a.ref_token,a.full_name,a.email,u.unit_code,'applied',a.desired_move_in,
 a.claimed_monthly_income,NULL,a.ref_token,a.status,a.decision,a.lease_status,
 a.verified_monthly_income,'none',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM message_log m WHERE m.message_id='mail-welcome-'||a.ref_token AND m.guardrail_result->>'delivery'='sent'),a.income_comparison->>'mismatch_flagged',
 a.income_comparison->>'document_variance_pct',a.updated_at
 FROM applications a JOIN units u ON u.id=a.unit_id WHERE a.lead_id IS NULL) p WHERE p.ref_token=$1 OR p.application_ref=$1
